description: Measured on the full log under the loop-count spike: skip_ws is entered 34.4M times and iterates 222,411 times, so it is almost always a call that returns at once; digits is entered 3.58M times. Experiment first, with predictions: when a self-recursive function's first clause decision exits without a call, emit that decision in the caller and call only when the loop continues. Not to be confused with the rejected rule B (calling loops natively), which stopped collections.
title: Experiment: a loop's exit test spliced into its caller
